title: Applied AI Engineer
required_skills: Digital product development, UX/HCI or service design experience (preferably with AI-enabled or technically complex services)
User-centered methods: user research, prototyping and usability testing
Ability to translate complex scientific/technical/data-intensive processes into clear user experiences
Strong Python experience (preferably with FastAPI or Django)
Hands-on experience developing or integrating AI/LLM-based applications, including conversational interfaces
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-assisted search and human-in-the-loop approaches
Understanding of generative AI limitations (hallucinations, uncertainty, provenance, explainability) and responsible AI
Experience evaluating AI-enabled systems (output reliability, retrieval quality, citations/answer traceability)

Understanding of AI security, privacy and responsible-AI principles (secure handling of sensitive data, data leakage, prompt injection, threat modelling, access control, provenance, safe use of third-party/external AI services)
Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating between user, scientific and technical perspectives
preferred_skills: Figma or comparable prototyping tools and more extensive UX/HCI or service-design experience
Experience with research infrastructures or other complex research environments (including scientific software)
Ontologies, knowledge graphs, FAIR data or semantic technologies
Experience with EU-funded collaborative projects or international research collaborations
responsibilities: Lead user research, persona development, user journeys, interaction design, prototyping and usability testing
Translate scientific use cases and research-infrastructure access workflows into product requirements, acceptance criteria and test scenarios
Shape the Research Navigator from early concepts and prototypes to a production-ready service
Design and evaluate conversational and AI-assisted user interactions, including presentation of recommendations, evidence, uncertainty and explanations
Develop components for RAG, agentic search, structured generation, tool calling and human-in-the-loop workflows, maintaining a modular model layer
Develop or contribute to MCP adapters, AI-facing APIs, and reusable integration components for open-source models
Establish systematic user-centered evaluation of the Navigator combining usability, accessibility, task success and trustworthiness
Contribute to responsible-AI implementation (transparency, explainability, privacy, accessibility, human oversight and user trust)
Contribute to project deliverables, demonstrations, consortium activities and development of reusable approaches for other European research infrastructures
